items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of school transport cost reimbursement
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Landratsamt Musterbreisgau, Stadtstraße 2, 79104 Musterfreiburg, Widerspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 11.07.2025 (the Bescheid itself is dated 08.07.2025, but the covering letter that was actually sent is dated 11.07.2025, so that is used as the posting day). Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG an authority letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Tue 15.07.2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts on 16.07.2025 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the delivery day: Fri 15.08.2025. That day is a Friday and not a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The Bescheid itself is dated 08.07.2025 but the covering letter was dated and apparently sent on 11.07.2025; the Widerspruch deadline here is calculated from the later date (11.07.2025) as the likely posting day — if the authority can show the letter was actually posted on or before 08.07.2025, the one-month deadline could fall a few days earlier, so it is safer to send the Widerspruch well before 15.08.2025.
